subject: sounds
title: Which long vowel?
about: Hear three words and tap the one with the long vowel asked for (a, e, i, o or u) with no key word to lean on, then name the vowel sound you hear inside a word. This is NC RF.1.3.a (telling long from short vowel sounds) using the magic-e and vowel-team words of RF.1.4.c, which CKLA teaches in Units 2 and 7.
tip: A long vowel says its own name: ask him which letter name he can hear inside the word.

cards.q: Which word has the long a sound?
cards.sayQ: Which word has the long A sound?
cards.note: gate: the a says its name. That is the long a. The e at the end is the magic e.

cards.q: Tap the word with the long a sound.
cards.sayQ: Tap the word with the long A sound.
cards.note: tray: ay says the name a. That is the long a.

cards.q: Which word has the long e sound?
cards.sayQ: Which word has the long E sound?
cards.note: tree: ee says the name e. That is the long e.

cards.q: Tap the word with the long e sound.
cards.sayQ: Tap the word with the long E sound.
cards.note: seal: ea says the name e. That is the long e.

cards.q: Listen for the long e. Which word has it?
cards.sayQ: Listen for the long E. Which word has it?
cards.note: queen: ee says the name e. That is the long e.

cards.q: Which word has the long i sound?
cards.sayQ: Which word has the long I sound?
cards.note: slide: the i says its name. That is the long i. The e at the end is the magic e.

cards.q: Tap the word with the long i sound.
cards.sayQ: Tap the word with the long I sound.
cards.note: nine: the i says its name. That is the long i.

cards.q: Listen for the long i. Which word has it?
cards.sayQ: Listen for the long I. Which word has it?
cards.note: light: igh says the name i. That is the long i.

cards.q: Which word has the long o sound?
cards.sayQ: Which word has the long O sound?
cards.note: rope: the o says its name. That is the long o. The e at the end is the magic e.

cards.q: Tap the word with the long o sound.
cards.sayQ: Tap the word with the long O sound.
cards.note: goat: oa says the name o. That is the long o.

cards.q: Listen for the long o. Which word has it?
cards.sayQ: Listen for the long O. Which word has it?
cards.note: stone: the o says its name. That is the long o.

cards.q: Which word has the long u sound?
cards.sayQ: Which word has the long U sound?
cards.note: cube: the u says its name. That is the long u. The e at the end is the magic e.

cards.q: What vowel sound do you hear in the word plane?
cards.sayQ: What vowel sound do you hear in the word plane? plane.
cards.note: plane: the a says its name, so it is the long a. Short a would sound like plan.

cards.q: What vowel sound do you hear in the word peach?
cards.sayQ: What vowel sound do you hear in the word peach? peach.
cards.note: peach: ea says the name e, so it is the long e.

cards.q: What vowel sound do you hear in the word mice?
cards.sayQ: What vowel sound do you hear in the word mice? mice.
cards.note: mice: the i says its name, so it is the long i. Short i would sound like miss.

cards.q: What vowel sound do you hear in the word soap?
cards.sayQ: What vowel sound do you hear in the word soap? soap.
cards.note: soap: oa says the name o, so it is the long o.

cards.q: Listen to the word huge. Which vowel sound is inside it?
cards.sayQ: Listen to the word huge. huge. Which vowel sound is inside it?
cards.note: huge: the u says its name, so it is the long u. Short u would sound like hug.

cards.q: What vowel sound do you hear in the word sock?
cards.sayQ: What vowel sound do you hear in the word sock? sock.
cards.note: sock: the o is short, like in hot. No letter name hides inside.

cards.q: Listen to the word fish. Which vowel sound is inside it?
cards.sayQ: Listen to the word fish. fish. Which vowel sound is inside it?
cards.note: fish: the i is short, like in pig. No letter name hides inside.
